name: Kitano Kenji
source:
Currently the famous manager of Hobby Shop Kitano. He is a warm and friendly person. He renovated “Toys no  Kitano” three years ago, and is a hardworking manager trying to survive the recession through online shopping. 

He is the “master of plastic model making” for many elementary school students, including the main character, and his skills are still legendary, but he laments the fact that children these days have no interest in plastic models. 

He married his wife, Takako, when he was over 30, so he is already 50 years old. He and his wife get along well. His chronic illnesses are back pain and presbyopia. He loves to drink. Drinking at a tavern “Kumakiri Izo” in the shopping arcade is his way of taking a break from life.

[from [url=http://autobahn69.jp/Autobahn/lovemilf.html] official site]
